// A little of everything the syntax mutators look at. Kept as .txt so that
// it is not analyzed or formatted with the package.
import 'dart:math' as math;

part 'shapes.g.dart';

@pragma('vm:prefer-inline')
const greeting = 'hello';
const limits = [1, 2, 3];

enum Kind { circle, square }

class Shape {
  Shape(this.kind, this.size) : assert(size >= 0);

  factory Shape.unit(Kind kind) {
    return Shape(kind, 1);
  }

  final Kind kind;
  final double size;
  String? label;
  int _reads = 0;

  double get area {
    _reads++;
    if (kind == Kind.circle) {
      return math.pi * size * size;
    } else {
      return size * size;
    }
  }

  set name(String? value) {
    label = value;
  }

  String describe({bool loud = false}) {
    final name = label;
    if (name == null) {
      return 'unnamed';
    }
    final text = '$name: ${area.toStringAsFixed(2)}' ' units';
    return loud ? text.toUpperCase() : text;
  }

  bool fits(Object other) {
    if (other is! Shape) {
      return false;
    }
    return other.size <= size && !(other.kind != kind || size < 0);
  }
}

int total(List<int> values, {int? cap}) {
  var sum = 0;
  for (var index = 0; index < values.length; index++) {
    sum += values[index];
  }
  var rounds = 0;
  while (rounds < 3) {
    rounds++;
    --sum;
  }
  do {
    sum -= 1;
  } while (sum > 100);
  sum *= 2;
  sum ~/= 3;
  cap ??= sum;
  return -(sum > cap ? cap : sum) % 7;
}

Future<void> save(Shape shape, void Function(String) log) async {
  log('saving');
  await Future<void>.value();
  StringBuffer();
  Shape.unit(shape.kind);
  log('saved ${shape.describe()}');
  try {
    shape.name = '';
  } on StateError {
    return;
  } finally {
    log("done");
  }
}

List<String> names(List<Shape> shapes, bool all) => [
  for (final shape in shapes)
    if (all || shape.label != null) shape.label ?? 'none',
  if (shapes.isEmpty) ...<String>[],
];

String pick(Object? value) => switch (value) {
  final int number when number > 0 => 'positive',
  String() => "text" r'raw',
  _ => '''
multi
''',
};

Iterable<int> count(int to) sync* {
  for (var value = 0; value < to; value++) {
    yield value + 1;
  }
}

dynamic loose(x) {
  if (x case final int number) {
    return number / 2;
  }
  assert(x != null, 'never');
  void inner() {
    return;
  }

  inner();
  return null;
}
